title: Jefferson County School Board, District 2
what_it_does: School board members set the district budget and school-tax rate, hire the superintendent (where appointed), approve school boundaries, curriculum policy and construction, and set district policies. Nonpartisan.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); both candidates are marked Qualified, which for a nonpartisan seat means the August vote did not produce a majority winner (or the seat is decided only in November). Positions have not been researched; check the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

candidates.name: Jamia Bradley
candidates.occupation: Voluntary Pre-Kindergarten teacher and early-childhood program director
candidates.background: Bradley is a 2000 graduate of Jefferson County High School who has spent more than a decade in early childhood education as a VPK teacher and program director. She was one of three candidates for the nonpartisan District 2 seat on the Aug. 18, 2026 ballot. Her stated focus is putting students first and removing barriers she says hold the community back.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

other_issues.title: Student opportunity and district growth
other_issues.summary: Bradley told WFSU she wants students to travel and see colleges outside the area before they graduate, and that the district should show growth alongside its improving school grades.

sources.title: Meet the candidates for Jefferson County's School Board District 2

candidates.name: Donnie Burdick
candidates.occupation: Substitute teacher, substitute coordinator and athletic safety coordinator, Jefferson County schools; retired law enforcement officer
candidates.background: Burdick graduated from Jefferson County High School in 1981, served in the U.S. Navy and then spent a career in law enforcement before returning to Jefferson County. He now works with the school district as a substitute teacher, substitute coordinator and athletic safety coordinator. He was one of three candidates for the nonpartisan District 2 seat on the Aug. 18, 2026 ballot.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

other_issues.title: Career and technical education
other_issues.summary: Burdick told WFSU the district offers no welding or cosmetology training and wants vocational planning to start in middle school, along with partnerships with colleges and instruction in basic life skills.

sources.title: Meet the candidates for Jefferson County's School Board District 2
